intendedUse: Normalize a current Italian CAP, retrieve only a competent rights-cleared real Polygon/MultiPolygon corresponding to it, fit the map and render a translucent area with source, reference date, classification and confidence.
recordGrain: one current Poste Italiane CAP assignment and its exact source-defined surface or honest non-area/unavailable reason

m2Definition.definition: A current rights-cleared nationwide Poste Italiane five-digit CAP assignment denominator, including grouped municipalities, multi-CAP cities, street arcs, civic-number range/parity, transition history and special/non-geographic classes, and either an authoritative postal-area Polygon/MultiPolygon or a rights-cleared membership-derived surface are pinned by edition, effective date, terms, attribution, CRS, topology, coverage, exceptions, method, uncertainty and SHA-256, published as an approved immutable artifact, and pass the real IT loader, API and app search-to-translucent-area path. Public CAP change PDFs, CAP Professional documentation or unlicensed rows, ANNCSU civic/address points, ISTAT administrative polygons, DBGT buildings, cadastral parcels, buffers, Voronoi cells, synthetic fixtures and invented route, PO box or organization surfaces never satisfy M2.

officialObservations.transitionRule: replaced CAP assignments remain valid for at least twelve months
officialObservations.finding: The competent operator confirms five-digit CAP semantics and the current effective update, but the public page does not publish a complete nationwide assignment or CAP Polygon/MultiPolygon release.
The archive has exactly two PDF change lists and no CSV, GeoJSON, Shapefile, GeoPackage, complete nationwide assignment or geometry payload.

The product describes municipalities, streets, arcs, civic ranges/parity and update tables. Download requires Poste registration/login and a PIN sent with a purchase order; documentation is not the current data and supplies no public area geometry.
The current FAQ describes a 36-month internal-use licence and says the database may not be transmitted or ceded to third parties. It does not authorize an AGID public artifact or API serving.
ANNCSU advertises national/regional monthly CSV ZIPs and daily APIs for address/civic data. The page is not a CAP assignment or postal-area release.

The official schema exposes municipality, ISTAT code, odonym, civic/access identity, number/suffix, metric and coordinate fields, but no CAP/postcode field. Direct deterministic byte capture failed, so no digest is claimed.
The national download was unavailable to this run. No bypass, credential, row extraction or address acquisition was attempted.

officialObservations.edition: administrative units as of 2026-01-01; page updated 2026-03-02
officialObservations.finding: ISTAT releases WGS84 regions, provinces/metropolitan cities and municipalities for statistical purposes. These are administrative boundaries, not CAP areas.

AGCOM states that Poste manages the CAP structure and announces introductions or boundary changes in advance under decision 384/17/CONS. This confirms authority but publishes no nationwide CAP polygons.

assignmentAudit.format: exactly five decimal digits stored as text

uniqueness.reason: The reviewed public package contains change PDFs, not the full denominator.

dataQuality.risk: No reviewed public source simultaneously provides a complete current assignment denominator, AGID publication rights and real CAP Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry. Administrative, civic, building and parcel substitutes would change the source grain and authority.

browserReview.reason: No rights-cleared real IT CAP Polygon/MultiPolygon exists to exercise. Shared deterministic UI tests verify capability without promoting synthetic Italy fixtures.

visualizationDecision.reason: The authority/rights/geometry matrix communicates the binary gate faithfully, and no lawful real surface exists to map.

blockerSummary: The current public Poste package is a two-PDF change set, not a complete assignment or polygon release. CAP Professional is purchased/authenticated and licensed for internal use without third-party transfer. ANNCSU's open address schema has no CAP field, and ISTAT boundaries are administrative. No rights-cleared real IT postal-area artifact exists.
unblockConditions: Obtain a current rights-cleared complete Poste Italiane nationwide CAP assignment with grouped municipality, multi-CAP street arc/range/parity, transition and special/non-geographic semantics.

Obtain an authoritative CAP Polygon/MultiPolygon release or a rights-cleared reproducible membership-derived surface with edition, effective date, terms, attribution, CRS, topology, complete members, exclusions, method, coverage, uncertainty, byte length and SHA-256.
Publish an approved immutable artifact without raw private address, customer, building, cadastral or land-right data.
Pass real IT normalization, loader, API, geometry validation, fit, translucent fill, outline, metadata, failure-state, clear and re-search verification.
